name: Escalation Transition Rule
description: One allowed move of an escalation matter's status, for a matter type and severity. A blank type, severity, from or to state means any. For each matter the most specific set of matching rules applies: type and severity, then type, then severity, then the rules that name neither.
provenance: REQUIREMENTS-COVERAGE.md E-8: workflow configurable by matter type and severity

fields.label: Rule Code
fields.description: Stable identifier. Deactivate a rule rather than deleting it, so the history of what was allowed stays readable.

fields.label: Escalation Type
fields.description: Leave empty to apply to every type.

fields.label: Severity
fields.description: Leave empty to apply to every severity.

fields.label: From Status
fields.options:
Open
In Progress
Under Review
Pending Review
Closed
Closed — Tracked Externally
fields.description: The state the matter is in. Leave empty for any state it can be worked in.

fields.label: To Status
fields.options:
Open
In Progress
Under Review
Pending Review
Closed
Closed — Tracked Externally
fields.description: The state it may move to, including the states it comes to rest in on closure. Leave empty for any.

fields.label: Allowed Role
fields.description: Who may make this move, on top of holding the matter at its stage. Leave empty for whoever holds it.
